brief_summary: Three top-housing outlines on a single stiffness axis — polycarbonate, nylon, Boba blend — each with sound arcs above it. Arcs get shorter and wider moving right; the Boba housing and its arcs render in coral. Annotations carry the two sourced material claims: softer than nylon, higher melting point than polycarbonate, composition unpublished.
